summary: Current readiness assessment against a practical LLM agent checklist. This file separates implemented capabilities from partial and planned work so resume claims stay evidence-backed.

implemented.evidence: app/tool_agent.py exposes get_dataset_contract, profile_dataset, select_quality_strategy, run_quality_checks, and build_quality_report as tool-calling functions.

implemented.capability: Tool results feed back into a multi-step agent loop
implemented.evidence: LLMDataQualityAgent.run appends tool results back into messages and continues for up to six tool-call rounds.

implemented.capability: Agent can analyze real business CSV exports and read-only PostgreSQL tables
API surface is published as a generated OpenAPI contract
implemented.evidence: docs/openapi.json is generated from FastAPI and verified for business-data, agent, trace, memory, and incident endpoints.

implemented.capability: Final reports are checked by deterministic guardrails
implemented.evidence: ReportVerifier validates finding evidence, known field references, sensitive evidence, unsupported LLM evidence, action coverage, and score bounds.

implemented.capability: Sanitized run traces can be persisted for auditability
implemented.evidence: TRACE_DB_PATH enables SQLite persistence for StoredRunTrace records, and tests verify recovery across RunTraceStore instances.

implemented.capability: Dataset-level memory retrieves recent historical trace summaries
implemented.evidence: RunTraceStore.list_by_dataset and /datasets/{dataset_id}/memory return recent sanitized traces, recurring checks, and recurring root-cause titles.

implemented.capability: Dataset memory retrieves recurring incident patterns from sanitized traces
implemented.evidence: docs/incident-pattern-memory.json is generated in CI and verifies 3 recurring support-ticket incident patterns from 2 sanitized traces.

implemented.capability: LLM agent can retrieve sanitized dataset memory inside the tool-calling loop
implemented.evidence: app/tool_agent.py exposes retrieve_dataset_memory and tests verify that recurring checks from prior traces are returned to the LLM before follow-up planning.

implemented.capability: Agent runs publish trace, fallback, verification, and memory observability
implemented.evidence: docs/agent-observability.json is generated in CI and summarizes trace ids, report types, fallback statuses, verification status, dataset memory, and tool-call previews.

implemented.capability: Agent safety boundaries are published as a generated evidence artifact
implemented.evidence: docs/agent-safety-boundaries.json is generated in CI and verifies tool allowlists, read-only PostgreSQL query limits, sensitive-field redaction, disabled fallback, and report verifier rules.
QualityReport.root_cause_hypotheses ranks likely causes by confidence and attaches supporting checks, evidence, and recommended actions.

implemented.capability: Root-cause hypotheses can be labeled by a human reviewer
implemented.evidence: docs/hypothesis-feedback.json records accepted and needs-review labels for generated support-ticket root-cause hypotheses.

implemented.capability: Agent degrades safely when no model key is configured
implemented.evidence: LLMDataQualityAgent returns DISABLED with an explicit fallback error instead of failing the API.

implemented.capability: Public evidence artifacts and scheduled health checks verify resume-safe claims
implemented.evidence: docs/outcome-evidence.json, docs/resume-evidence.md, and Public Evidence Health workflow track verifiable signals.

partial.capability: Memory now feeds into the LLM tool loop, but ranking does not yet learn from accepted human labels
partial.current_state: The agent can call retrieve_dataset_memory to inspect sanitized prior traces, recurring checks, and incident patterns before continuing its plan.
partial.next_step: Use accepted or needs-review hypothesis labels to tune future root-cause ranking.

partial.capability: Business-rule retrieval exists, but there is no embedding/vector-search RAG layer
partial.current_state: Support-ticket rules are source-cited from local Markdown rules.
partial.next_step: Add optional embedding-backed retrieval with source citations and permission filtering.

partial.capability: Trace summaries and run artifacts exist, but production-grade observability is incomplete
partial.current_state: The API exposes sanitized run summaries, tool-call previews, and a generated observability artifact for trace, fallback, verification, and memory status.
partial.next_step: Track model version, prompt version, token usage, latency breakdown, retries, and estimated cost.

partial.capability: Evaluation artifacts exist, but the eval set is still small
partial.current_state: Tests check fallback behavior, tool use, evidence support, public artifacts, and root-cause hypothesis labels.
partial.next_step: Add a larger labeled eval set for tool-choice accuracy, finding recall, false positives, and cost.

planned.deliverable: Use accepted hypothesis labels to adjust incident-pattern ranking
planned.resume_value: Shows feedback-informed memory, not only historical trace retrieval.

planned.deliverable: Add human approval boundary for generated remediation SQL or ticket actions
planned.resume_value: Shows AI safety and enterprise workflow judgment.

planned.deliverable: Use accepted or needs-review hypothesis labels in future ranking and memory retrieval
planned.resume_value: Shows a closed-loop agent evaluation workflow.
